name: Sonicos WhatsApp Bot
description: A Go WhatsApp bot built with whatsmeow, SQLite, Redis, and a password-protected web onboarding dashboard.

DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite file URL for the WhatsApp linked-device session.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL. Use a managed Redis-compatible service.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password (alphanumeric or numeric) required to unlock the web onboarding dashboard for QR or phone-number WhatsApp linking.
